graph_runtime.reason: FSDK runtime elements (ca-certificates, glib, gnutls, podman, linux-firmware, etc.) declare python3 for build-time data generation. elements/oci/rootfs.bst deletes all Python interpreters and scripts from the shipped tree; the content-layer check enforces that.
